source: Public-domain melodies for Pan's pieces, written out for flute in concert pitch (tinyNotation: c = C4, c' = C5; b- = B flat). Not ABRSM's lists: ABRSM's flute pieces are copyrighted arrangements, so each grade gets traditional and classical tunes at its level, filed under List A (lively), B (lyrical) and C (other styles) as the exam asks for one of each.
